title: Definitions.
bodyText:
As used in this chapter, unless the context otherwise requires:

"Board" means the board of directors of the criminal justice research institute.

"Institute" means the criminal justice research institute.
bodyHtml:
[§614-1]  Definitions.  As used in this chapter, unless the context otherwise requires:

     "Board" means the board of directors of the criminal justice research institute.

     "Institute" means the criminal justice research institute. [L 2019, c 179, pt of §24]
